title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents

rs.key_step: 只持久化轨迹/outcome和mode反馈，任务指导临时合成后丢弃；contextual selector选择direct/imitation/strategic/corrective。
rs.why_non_obvious: 删抽象避免直接复用但仍会经行为轨迹间接再生错误，不能称彻底去污染。
rs.trigger_condition: When stored guidance reproduces errors, retain execution records and synthesize temporary task-specific guidance.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When derived beliefs become persistent errors, separate raw experience storage from temporary abstraction.

signatures.information: training执行轨迹/outcome；近邻相关性和recency反馈
signatures.operation: 固定backbone，cost-aware UCB-inspired mode选择并临时指导
signatures.claimed_effect: 九个benchmark/backbone组合中7个heldout success最高；3seeds，平均LLMcall最低但具体数字抽取缺失。

evidence.quote: Anti-persistence achieved the highest success rate in seven of the nine benchmark–backbone settings

signatures.failure_boundary: HTML丢失公式/表数字，未取得完整量化；保留轨迹仍允许间接errorreproduction。

relevance.how: 历史错误指导反复再生，可迁移记忆审计，但本地材料不支持完整定量重建。
